summary: iter-423 Chunk F, Asks 1 & 2. BACKEND ✅ 7/7 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter423_advanced_clinical_reopen.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter423_reopen.xml). New endpoint POST /api/procedures/{id}/advanced-clinical/reopen validated end-to-end on seed 6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69 (Zygoma and Pterygoid Implants): (T1) student → 403 'Role student cannot reopen Advanced Clinical'; (T2) non-Zygoma procedure → 400 'Not a Zygoma/Pterygoid case'; (T3) already-draft → 200 {ok:true, already_draft:true} — DB unchanged (approval_status remains 'draft', reopen_log stays empty, no phantom log entry appended); (T4) approved → 200 with body {ok:true, approval_status:'draft'}, DB phase2_data.advanced_clinical.approval_status flipped to 'draft', reopen_log[0] populated with {from_status:'approved', reopened_by_name, reopened_by_role, reopened_at (ISO)}, all 4 approver stamps (approved_by/approved_by_name/approved_by_role/approved_at) cleared; second call returns already_draft (idempotent); (T5) pending → 200, status flipped to 'draft', reopen_log[-1].from_status='pending'; (T6) Supervisor Paresh.gandhi → 200 (reopened_by_role='supervisor'). Cleanup leaves case in draft state. FRONTEND ⚠️ code-inspection PASS, live-render blocked by seed-data. Attempted live verification as Abhijit.patil (implant_incharge) AND Paresh.gandhi (supervisor) at /procedures/6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69 → the page returns 'Procedure not found' for both because the case has supervisor_id='x' / implant_incharge_id='x' / student_id=None (invalid ObjectIds, unassigned) AND the implant_plans collection is empty (no rows for procedure_id=6a8337dd…). Case-details, submit-phase2, and PhaseTabbedAutoFetch all early-return without rendering AdvancedClinicalCard. This is a seed-data limitation, NOT a code defect — the backend reopen endpoint itself bypasses ownership checks (only role-gated) and returned 200 for both Abhijit and Paresh. Code-inspection verification of Ask 1 & Ask 2 frontend logic: (A1.1) AdvancedClinicalCard.tsx:104 `const readOnly = approvalStatus !== 'draft';` correctly locks ZAGA inputs (L232,237 editable={!readOnly}), toggles (L251 disabled={readOnly}), and day pickers (L269 onPress={() => !readOnly && setPickerFor(day)}); (A1.2) per-day DONE pills at L273 render inside the map only when dayFilled truthy — testIDs `adv-day-day0-done-pill` / `adv-day-day7-done-pill` / `adv-day-day30-done-pill`; (A1.3) send-approval button at L303-308 gated on `approvalStatus === 'draft' && (day0Filled || closeOutReady.ready)` — testID adv-send-approval; (A1.4) locking-soon banner at L292 gated on `closeOutReady.ready && approvalStatus === 'draft'` — testID adv-locking-soon, does NOT touch readOnly (pickers stay editable); (A1.5) reopen button at L329 gated by `canReopen` (L105 = status !== 'draft' && role in supervisor/implant_incharge/administrator), testID adv-reopen, onPress triggers Alert.alert confirm modal (L188-195) then POSTs /advanced-clinical/reopen (L178) then flips local state to draft (L181); (A1.6) closeOutReady memo at L81-93 fires when current_phase >= 3 OR (Date.now() - surgery_date) >= 30 days — matches spec exactly. (A2) submit-phase2/[id].tsx: L331-334 isZygPtrPosition matches /^(ZR|ZL|PR|PL)/; L335-342 iopaImplantPositions filter !zygPtr, zygPtrImplantPositions filter zygPtr; L343 needsOpg = isFullArch || zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0; L344 needsIopa = iopaImplantPositions.length > 0; L346-351 getIopaLabel prefers iopaImplantPositions[idx] (Conventional FDI, e.g. 'Implant 12'), never falls back to Zygoma R1 as long as iopaImplantPositions is populated; section-title logic L1710-1714 produces exactly the 4 documented variants ('Post Surgical Radiographs - OPG' when needsOpg && !needsIopa, plural/singular IOPA when !needsOpg && needsIopa, plural/singular legacy when neither — but neither is impossible since at least one is always true given implantPositions>0); combined layout L1719-1795 (IOPA sub-title 'Post Surgical Radiograph - IOPA (Conventional Implants)') + L1796-1820 (OPG sub-title 'Post Surgical Radiographs - OPG (Zygoma / Pterygoid Implants)'); submit validation L503-529 enforces IOPA if needsIopa (per-implant IOPA required) and OPG if needsOpg with Zygoma/Pterygoid-flavoured error message when zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0; missRadiographs progress meter L755-770 shows 'Post Surgical Radiograph - OPG (Zygoma/Pterygoid implants)' when zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0 and skips IOPA rung entirely when !needsIopa. Live spot-check on submit-phase2 rendered 'Post Surgical Radiographs' (base title) because implant_plans was empty ⇒ implantPositions=[] ⇒ needsOpg=false && needsIopa=false ⇒ falls through to legacy plural title — this is the correct behaviour for a 0-implant edge case, not a bug. Screenshots: /tmp/iter423_case_details_after_reopen.png (Procedure not found overlay confirms ownership issue).

This blocks live frontend rendering on /procedures/[id] and PhaseTabbedAutoFetch (needsIopa/needsOpg both false since implantPositions=[]). If main agent needs to visually validate Ask 1 & Ask 2 in-app, re-seed implant_plans (5 rows: ZR1/ZL1/PR1 + 2 conventional FDI like 14/24 for the combined Case H matrix) AND reassign supervisor_id / implant_incharge_id to a real user ObjectId. Backend behaviour is 100% verified without this.

P4 (spec parity check): AdvancedClinicalCard `sendForApproval` (L142-152) prompts a soft-confirm Alert when Day 30 is not filled — this is per iter-Jun-2026 Chunk B Ask 3, but Chunk F Ask 1 spec only mentions the day0/closeOutReady visibility gate. If product wants a hard-block instead, tighten the gate in the button visibility rather than the handler. Non-blocking; current behaviour is documented in code comments.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:2857-2912 — reopen endpoint is clean: role gate → ObjectId lookup → procedure_type gate → idempotent branch → mutate + audit-log + clear approver stamps. datetime.utcnow().isoformat() used consistently. `adv.pop(...)` on missing keys is safe (default None). $set path 'phase2_data.advanced_clinical' correctly targets the nested doc without clobbering other phase2_data fields.

backend/server.py:2882 — `adv = (p2.get('advanced_clinical') or {}).copy()` creates a shallow copy before mutation; the write at L2910 replaces the entire nested doc which is fine because the copy is a full serialisation of the prior state. No race-condition risk from partial merge.
backend/server.py:2897 — `log = list(adv.get('reopen_log') or [])` shallow-copies existing log before append; original doc is untouched until the $set write. Good.

backend/server.py:2903-2906 — clears exactly the 4 stamp fields mentioned in the spec (approved_by, approved_by_name, approved_by_role, approved_at). Doesn't clear ORIS toggle answers, sinus-lift flags, or day 0/7/30 dates — matches the spec intent (reopen for editing, not reset).

AdvancedClinicalCard.tsx:81-93 — closeOutReady memo dependency array is [procedure] — the memo will recompute on any procedure prop change, but the underlying reads (current_phase, surgery_date, phase2_submitted_at) are stable. surgery_date fallback chain (phase2_data.surgery_date → phase2_submitted_at → procedure.surgery_date) matches iter-421 convention.

AdvancedClinicalCard.tsx:104 — readOnly derives from approval_status !== 'draft' only. This intentionally locks BOTH pending AND approved (spec requirement 1). No separate `disabled` prop needed on individual controls beyond `readOnly`/`editable`/`disabled` on each input.

AdvancedClinicalCard.tsx:105 — canReopen requires BOTH status != draft AND role check; already-draft cases correctly hide the button (would return already_draft:true anyway, but hiding the CTA is a nicer UX).

AdvancedClinicalCard.tsx:174-196 — reopen() handler wraps the API call in a nested proceed() closure gated on Alert.alert confirm — matches the sendForApproval pattern for consistency. Local state flip to 'draft' at L181 is a good optimistic update; onChanged() re-fetches the canonical state from the server.

submit-phase2/[id].tsx:331-344 — helper set is pure and memoized; no dependency on external state beyond `implantPositions`. `startsWith` on 'ZR'/'ZL'/'PR'/'PL' matches all valid zygoma/pterygoid position codes (ZR1, ZR2, ZL1, ZL2, PR1, PR2, PL1, PL2). No FDI collision risk since Conventional FDI codes are always numeric.

submit-phase2/[id].tsx:346-351 — getIopaLabel prefers the Conventional-only filtered array; the fallback to implantPositions[idx] is guarded by index-alignment (iopaFiles.length === iopaImplantPositions.length after re-seed) — no crash risk on Case H/I/J. `implantDisplayLabel(iopaImplantPositions[idx])` returns 'Implant N' for FDI codes, never 'Zygoma R1'.

submit-phase2/[id].tsx:503-529 — validation logic is correctly ordered: IOPA required only when needsIopa is true (line 505), OPG required when needsOpg is true (line 517) with a Zygoma/Pterygoid-flavoured error when zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0 (matches spec requirement for Cases D-J).

submit-phase2/[id].tsx:755-770 — missRadiographs progress meter matches spec exactly: OPG rung labelled 'Post Surgical Radiograph - OPG (Zygoma/Pterygoid implants)' when zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0, and IOPA rung completely omitted when !needsIopa (pure Zygoma/Pterygoid case).

submit-phase2/[id].tsx:1710-1714 — section title is a 4-way ternary. Covers all combinations; the singular/plural legacy fallback at the tail is only reachable when both flags are false (implantPositions=[] edge case) — matches Case A/B legacy behaviour and observed on the empty-plan seed.
